answer: Cross-epoch fingerprint matching: each identity’s action graph is hashed per epoch, and every new epoch must share a stable vertex of behavioural similarity with its own prior history or be quarantined. An identity sitting at its nadir of consistency loses routing weight until it re-establishes that overlap. Attackers must sustain coherent behaviour across many epochs, and any clone revealing a shared lagoon of correlated histories links both identities for slashing.
